notes.title: Demo Day Hurdle Event
notes.notes:
Before officially starting our activities, we’ve planned a few [b]Demo Day events[/b] for you to enjoy, including our biggest one, the [b]Hurdle Event[/b]. This event invites our valued players to complete missions based on the requirements listed below.

[b]Event Details[/b]
After the Demo Day ends, the event items will be provided to all players at the start of Preseason based on hurdle completion.

[b]Requirements : [/b]Log in within 7 days of the Pre-season start to receive hurdle-cleared items once per account.

[b]One-Time Login Reward[/b]
During Demo Day, log in to receive a special reward for meeting the conditions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45084467/fe68c972275b1b422ef76f5dd913443f2f84c896.jpg[/img]

[*] Over 1,000 participants: 30,000 Gold awarded

[*] Over 1 Million Crystals produced in-game: Leather Greaves x1
[*] Over 10 Million Gold spent in-game: Leather Vambrace x1
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Day Schedule Announcement
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45084467/09c766d449779c0fa971c132065d036869d21e38.png[/img]
Hello, Hunters!
The season launch of Hunters Arena: Revolution is just around the corner.

Before the season begins, we’ve prepared a special opportunity for a limited number of players to experience the warzone early through Demo Day.

The warzone will open immediately after the Demo Day live streaming with BNB, starting on December 4 at 11:00 UTC

You can enjoy the game until December 6 at 06:00 UTC.
We appreciate your interest and support for Hunters Arena: Revolution.
Special events have been prepared for Demo Day, so don’t miss this great opportunity to earn massive rewards!

See you all soon in the arena.
Thank you!

notes.title: Hunter's Arena: Revolution CBT has ended!
notes.notes:
Greetings Hunters,

The week long CBT has recently ended.
Approximately 1,000 users participated in the CBT and many have sent in their opinions about it.

We have gathered all the opinions and will be revamping the game.

[list]
[*]A tutorial is currently in development. We will also make it easy to obtain information through a game guide that will be available on the web and in-game.[/list]
[list][*]A new mode (app) for new users and beginners is also in development. Even if you don't know much about the game, you can enjoy it without any worries.[/list]
[list][*]Camera visibility will be improved as well.[/list]
[list][*]The overall feel of operations and movement will be adjusted too.[/list]
[list][*]Additional escape areas will be added to provide more opportunities for escape and a sense of accomplishment.[/list]

In addition, areas that users found to be inconvenient such as the UI/UX and sound will be corrected as well. We will return with improved features and richer content.

Stay tuned for more to come~

notes.title: Hunter's Arena: Revolution CBT Now Live!
notes.notes:
Hunters!
The first official CBT of Hunter's Arena: Revolution is now live!

If you have requested access to the CBT via Hunter's Arena: Revolution Playtest and were selected for the CBT, please check the Hunter's Arena: Revolution Steam Page to download and play the game.

As a reminder, the CBT will go on from July 18th 12:00 ~ July 24 07:00 (UTC)

✦Notes ✦
1. This is a closed beta test for Hunter's Arena: Revolution. All test content is still in development and does not represent the final game quality.
2. Test eligibility applies only to this test and all game data will be deleted after the test.
3. This hunt takes place on servers in North America and Asia. Hunters not in those specific regions may experience disconnections and lag during the game. We sincerely apologize if you have any negative experiences because of this.
4. Please check the minimum and recommended game specifications carefully.
✦For more details, please visit the link below.
Discord: https://discord.gg/megalink

notes.title: Hunter's Arena: Revolution CBT Announcement
notes.notes:
The action extraction game, Hunter's Arena: Revolution is now on Steam. We'll start the recruitment for our CBT right away. We're looking for those who want to be the first to hunt in this immersive ancient orient fantasy world.

The first hunt officially begins on July 18, 2024 (UTC+0). To participate in this hunt, you must apply through the Steam Playtest. Game data will not be carried over into future testing or the official live version of the game.

Duration Schedule
UTC+0 : July 18 01:00 ~ July 24
(KST : July 18 10:00 ~ July 24)
EST : July 18 ~ 24

For those who were not selected this time around, there is no need to worry. Bigger content and battles will come to fruition in the near future. Please subscribe to the page and click on the 'Wishlist' to stay up to date on the latest news about the game.
See you in the battlefield soon!
